text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock A and E after gains felt reassuring, but my sale price relative to cost says nothing about where prices go next; I should follow a consistent plan rather than try to lock in a win.","I should evaluate the portfolio as a whole, including cash and risk, instead of treating each holding as a separate account or holding on just to avoid admitting a loss.","My account value still fell after several profitable sales, and the later buys did not make outcomes predictable; I should diversify and avoid trading on the assumption that past price moves will continue."]}
